2.163.12
GaugePanel.ToolTip
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.ToolTip element specifies a textual label for a GaugePanel that is used for things
such as specifying title and alt attributes in HTML reports. The alt attribute can be used to render
alternative text (alt text). The GaugePanel.ToolTip element is optional. If this element is present, its
value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.ToolTip element.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="StringLocIDType" minOccurs="0">
